title: Minimum Time to Gather Friends
statement:
The main road of Bytecity is a straight line running from south to north. Positions on it are measured in meters from the southernmost building, towards the north. At some points of the road stand `n` friends: friend `i` is at position `x[i]` and can move in either direction (south or north) at any speed **not greater than** `v[i]` meters per second. Several friends may start at the same position.

The friends want to gather at one point of the road as soon as possible. The meeting point does **not** have to be an integer coordinate, and a friend who arrives early may simply wait there.

The true minimum time is generally not an integer, so this problem asks for it in a form that can be printed exactly: output the smallest non-negative integer `m` such that all `n` friends can be at one common point after `m / 1000` seconds, that is, the minimum gathering time in seconds multiplied by 1000 and rounded **up** to the next integer.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` integers `x[0] ... x[n-1]`.
The third line contains `n` integers `v[0] ... v[n-1]`.
outputFormat: Print a single integer `m`: the minimum gathering time in milliseconds, rounded up.

examples.explanation: They close the gap of 10 meters at a combined speed of 1 + 4 = 5 m/s, so they can meet after exactly 2 seconds (friend 0 walks 2 m, friend 1 walks 8 m). In milliseconds that is 2000.
The gap is 1 meter and the combined speed is 3 m/s, so the exact time is 1/3 s = 333.33... ms, which rounds up to 334.
The two outermost friends need 7 / (3 + 1) = 1.75 s to meet, at position 7.25. The friend at position 5 can reach 7.25 within 1.25 s, so he is no obstacle: the answer is 1750.

hints: Fix a time t. Friend i can reach any point in the interval [x[i] - v[i]·t, x[i] + v[i]·t]. When can all friends meet?
They can meet exactly when all of these intervals have a common point, i.e. the largest left end is at most the smallest right end. This check is monotone in t.
Binary search on the integer m (time m / 1000) and test feasibility with integers: max(1000·x[i] - v[i]·m) ≤ min(1000·x[i] + v[i]·m). No floating point is needed.
